title: Creation of a ring
body: spsc_ring_init(capacity) shall return a new empty ring when capacity is a non-zero power of two and capacity times sizeof(int) fits in size_t, and NULL otherwise; a failed allocation shall return NULL with nothing left allocated.
rationale: The capacity is the customer's, fixed at the operator's start (SSS-003); a creation that fails must say so and leak nothing (SSS-005).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: powers of two accepted, 0 and non-powers refused, each allocation failure returns NULL and frees what was taken.

title: Every slot usable
body: A ring of capacity N shall accept N pushes from empty and refuse the next one; it is empty when its two counters are equal and full when they differ by N.
rationale: Full counters, not masked indexes, remove the lost slot of the classic design (SSS-003).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: a ring filled to its capacity is full, one more push is refused.

title: First in, first out, exactly once
body: The values popped shall be the values pushed, each exactly once and in the order pushed.
rationale: The listener's order of hand-off is the operator's order of service (SSS-001).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (FIFO order); tests/ITs/integration_tests.c (two threads); tests/stress/stress_mt.c (8,000,000 values, a per-value bitmap).

title: A full ring refuses a push at once
body: spsc_ring_push() on a full ring shall return -1 and change nothing; on a NULL ring it shall return -1.
rationale: The listener answers from a reject slot when the operator cannot take a connection (SSS-002, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: a push on a full ring returns -1 and the ring keeps its contents.

title: An empty ring refuses a pop at once
body: spsc_ring_pop() on an empty ring shall return -1 and leave the caller's variable untouched; a NULL output pointer shall discard the value popped.
rationale: The operator drains until the ring answers none (SSS-004, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: a pop on an empty ring returns -1; a pop with NULL output removes the value.

title: The producer publishes with release
body: spsc_ring_push() shall write the slot before it advances the tail with a release store, and shall read the head with an acquire load before it decides the ring is not full.
rationale: The release publishes the value to the consumer; the acquire makes the consumer's read of a slot happen before the producer overwrites it (IRD-004).
criteria: An inspection of push and is_full against C11 7.17; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c and the stress under ThreadSanitizer report no race.

title: The consumer reads after acquire
body: spsc_ring_pop() shall read the tail with an acquire load before it reads the slot, and shall advance the head with a release store after the read.
rationale: The acquire pairs with the producer's release so the value read is the value written; the release hands the slot back (IRD-004).
criteria: An inspection of pop and is_empty against C11 7.17; the threaded suites under ThreadSanitizer report no race.

title: Push and pop are wait-free
body: Each call of spsc_ring_push() and spsc_ring_pop() shall finish in a bounded number of its own steps, whatever the other thread does: no loop, no lock, no system call, no allocation.
rationale: Neither the listener nor an operator may ever wait on the other (SSS-002, SSS-004).
criteria: An inspection of push and pop: straight-line code, two atomic loads and one atomic store each.

title: Lock-free counters or no ring
body: spsc_ring_init() shall return NULL when either 64-bit counter is not lock-free on the target (atomic_is_lock_free); a build defining SPSC_REQUIRE_ALWAYS_LOCK_FREE shall fail to compile on a target whose 64-bit atomics are not always lock-free.
rationale: A lock-backed atomic would make the wait-free calls take a lock (SRS-008, SSS-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c (each counter reported lock-backed through the seam: NULL); the release build defines the switch.

title: Head and tail never share a cache line
body: The consumer's head and the producer's tail shall sit at least SPSC_CACHELINE (64) bytes apart, checked at compile time.
rationale: False sharing would bounce one cache line between the listener's core and the operator's on every hand-off.
criteria: The _Static_assert of app/spscring.c compiles in every profile.

title: Counters that never wrap in service
body: The head and tail shall be 64-bit counters that only increase between a creation and a reset; at 10^6 hand-offs a second they wrap after about 584,000 years (2^64 / 10^6 s), at 10^9 after about 584 years.
rationale: A box serves for months between restarts (SSS-005); a 32-bit counter would wrap in 71 minutes at 10^6 a second.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: the size stays within the capacity across a long wrap-around sequence; an analysis of the counter width.

title: Queries are snapshots
body: spsc_ring_is_empty(), spsc_ring_is_full() and spsc_ring_size() shall answer a snapshot that may change at once; spsc_ring_size() shall read the head before the tail and clamp to the capacity, so that it never exceeds the capacity and never underflows.
rationale: The queries serve observation and the two sides' own checks; an underflow would show ~2^64 queued values.
criteria: tests/ITs/integration_tests.c: an observer thread samples the size while both sides run and never sees more than the capacity.

title: Every call tolerates NULL
body: With a NULL ring, push and pop shall return -1, is_empty 1, is_full 0, capacity and size 0, and reset and destroy do nothing; destroy shall also accept a NULL pointer to the ring pointer, and set the caller's pointer to NULL after freeing.
rationale: A consumer's teardown runs on half-built state (IRD-001, IRD-002).
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: every function called with NULL; destroy twice.

title: Reset only while both sides stand still
body: spsc_ring_reset() shall empty the ring; it is not safe while either thread uses the ring.
rationale: The relaxed stores of the reset publish nothing to a running side.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c: after a reset the ring is empty and takes pushes again.

title: Any int, carried as it is
body: The ring shall store any int value, independent of the width of its counters.
rationale: The platform carries socket descriptors; the library knows nothing of what the value means.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c and the stress carry values 1 to 8,000,000 and read them back.

title: The ABI is gated
body: abi/layout.txt shall describe the public ABI of app/spscring.h; the shared object shall export exactly the nine declared functions as <name>@@SPSCRING_1; a changed line of the layout shall need a new major, a new public name a new minor.
rationale: A consumer built against another major fails at load, never at run time (IRD-005).
criteria: The pipeline's stages abi and abi-exports pass.

title: Two packages, reproducible
body: The library shall be delivered as libspscring (the shared object and its soname link) and libspscring-dev (the header, the static archive, the linker link), the second depending on the first at the same version, built to the same bytes from the same commit.
rationale: The platform pins both by SHA-256 (SSS-006).
criteria: The pipeline's stages package and package-smoke pass; the SHA256SUMS of the debs.

title: A hardened release
body: The release shared object shall pass kyr-build's hardening check: full RELRO, immediate binding, a non-executable stack, stack canaries, fortified calls, no RPATH, a versioned soname.
rationale: The ring sits in the box's front door (SSS-006).
criteria: The pipeline's check_hardening on the release artifacts and its glibc-ceiling stage pass.

title: Nothing linked but the C library
body: At run time the library shall depend on the C library alone; deps.txt shall name only build and test tools.
rationale: Tier 1 of the platform: nothing under it (SSS-006).
criteria: Inspection of deps.txt and the shared object's NEEDED entries.

title: Test seams never shipped
body: The allocation and lock-free test seams shall be compiled only with SPSC_RING_TESTING, in the coverage and sanitizer runs, and never in a shipped artifact; the release library shall export no test symbol.
rationale: The seams replace aligned_alloc, calloc and free; a shipped seam would be a hook into every consumer.
criteria: The release unit tests link against the shipped library without the seams; abi-exports finds exactly the nine functions.

title: Verified under every profile that runs the suites
body: The unit suite shall pass against the release library, the unit and integration suites together shall cover 100 % of the lines and branches of app/spscring.c, both shall pass under ASan, UBSan and LSan, the integration suite and a reduced stress under ThreadSanitizer, and the full stress on the release archive.
rationale: The customer takes a release only with its concurrent paths run under the thread sanitizer (SSS-007).
criteria: The release pipeline at the release commit: every stage passed.

title: One producer and one consumer per ring
body: The caller guarantees, for the whole life of a ring, that exactly one thread pushes and exactly one other thread pops.
rationale: kyr_host's listener is the only producer of every operator's ring, and the operator's thread its only consumer (IRD-003).

title: Creation, reset and destruction while the ring is quiet
body: The caller creates, resets and destroys a ring only while neither the producer nor the consumer uses it.
rationale: kyr_host creates each ring in operator_init() and destroys it in operator_shutdown(), its thread joined.

title: A 64-bit target with lock-free 64-bit atomics
body: The library runs on a 64-bit target (x86-64, aarch64) whose 64-bit atomics are lock-free.
rationale: The box's targets; SRS-009 refuses any other.

title: The ring handle
body: typedef struct spsc_ring spsc_ring_t: an opaque type, held by pointer; its layout is the library's.
rationale: Every call takes the handle; the consumer never sees the counters.
criteria: Inspection of app/spscring.h against abi/layout.txt.

title: spsc_ring_init()
body: spsc_ring_t* spsc_ring_init(uint64_t capacity): a new empty ring of capacity slots (a non-zero power of two), or NULL for an invalid capacity, a failed allocation or a target without lock-free 64-bit atomics. Not thread-safe.
rationale: The one way to get a ring.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c.

title: spsc_ring_push()
body: int spsc_ring_push(spsc_ring_t* ring, int fd): 0 when fd is stored, -1 when the ring is full or NULL; producer thread only; wait-free.
rationale: The listener's hand-off.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: spsc_ring_pop()
body: int spsc_ring_pop(spsc_ring_t* ring, int* out_fd): 0 when a value is taken (written to *out_fd unless out_fd is NULL), -1 when the ring is empty or NULL; consumer thread only; wait-free.
rationale: The operator's take.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: The queries
body: int spsc_ring_is_empty(spsc_ring_t*), int spsc_ring_is_full(spsc_ring_t*), uint64_t spsc_ring_capacity(const spsc_ring_t*), uint64_t spsc_ring_size(const spsc_ring_t*): snapshots; with NULL 1, 0, 0 and 0.
rationale: What a caller may ask without taking or giving a value.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c; tests/ITs/integration_tests.c.

title: spsc_ring_reset() and spsc_ring_destroy()
body: void spsc_ring_reset(spsc_ring_t* ring): empty the ring, not thread-safe. void spsc_ring_destroy(spsc_ring_t** ring): free the ring and its buffer and set *ring to NULL; NULL and a NULL *ring are no-ops.
rationale: The end of a ring's life.
criteria: tests/UTs/unit_tests.c.

title: Library linkage
body: libspscring.so.1 (soname major 1) exports exactly the nine functions of app/spscring.h as <name>@@SPSCRING_1 (utils/spscring.map); libspscring.a carries the same functions; a consumer includes <spscring.h>.
rationale: A consumer built against another major fails at load.
criteria: The pipeline's abi and abi-exports stages; tests/package/smoke.c.

title: The packages
body: libspscring_<version>_<arch>.deb: /usr/local/lib/libspscring.so.<version> and its soname link; libspscring-dev_<version>_<arch>.deb: /usr/local/include/spscring.h, /usr/local/lib/libspscring.a and the libspscring.so link, depending on libspscring (= <version>); both replace the former single package spscring.
rationale: What the platform installs and pins.
criteria: utils/smoke_test_package.sh builds tests/package/smoke.c against the installed packages alone.

title: Build-time switches
body: SPSC_REQUIRE_ALWAYS_LOCK_FREE (the project's builds define it: a target without always-lock-free 64-bit atomics fails to compile); SPSC_CACHELINE (64 by default: the layout only, never the behaviour); SPSC_RING_TESTING (the test seams, never in a shipped build).
rationale: A consumer compiling the source must know what each switch changes.
criteria: Inspection of app/spscring.c and utils/spscring_project.sh.
